articles.title: Solve a Crime with Fake Blood Spatter!
articles.summary: Ever wonder how detectives use blood drops to solve crimes? You can find out with a cool experiment using fake blood. See how drop size changes with height!

articles.title: Dark Matter's Secret Force Slows Down the Universe!
articles.summary: Scientists thought a hidden force in dark matter would speed up galaxy growth. But a new study shows it actually slows things down. Weird, right?

articles.title: New Sunscreen Ingredient Finally Approved in the U.S.!
articles.summary: The FDA just approved bemotrizinol, a sunscreen chemical used in Europe for 25 years. It blocks aging rays better and stays on longer. Look for it this summer!
